title: Q-METRIC-declared-probes: Give the declared metrics M-generator and M-outreach real probes
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** grep:instances/ultrastable/objectives.json::"source": "sql"
**Status:** closed

Gap in component `objectives`: M-generator and M-outreach are declared, so they breach by design until probed (OBJECTIVES-1). Expose test results and the outreach ledger send count as sql or http probes and change their source from declared.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 220.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
